profile: feature matrix: a matrix of node features, typically denoted X and also known as the node feature matrix or input feature matrix. X is equated with H_0 and serves as the input to a graph neural network. The input feature matrix is denoted X^l, and X' also appears in this context. The matrix supplies d features to the GNN block.
